title: STOKER’S APPLE 16OZ LOOSE LEAF CHEWING TOBACCO
description:
STOKER’S APPLE 16OZ LOOSE LEAF CHEWING TOBACCO

STOKER’S APPLE 16OZ LOOSE LEAF CHEWING TOBACCO is a classic loose leaf-style chewing tobacco product. Loose leaf chewing tobacco is the most common type of chewing tobacco. It simply consists of shredded tobacco leaves. Stoker’s Apple 16oz Leaf Chewing is manufactured by National Tobacco Company and has a robust tobacco flavor, with fruity hints of apple. The nicotine strength is 2 on a 5-grade scale, placing it within the “normal” range compared to similar chewing tobacco products. Chewing tobacco can also be experienced in plug and long cut. You can find more classic chewing tobacco on the Stoker’s brand page.
